data.body: Post-rebase verification: merged fixture repairs made all seven temporary exclusions stale, and the fail-closed guard correctly went RED (1 failed, 24 passed). The obsolete exclusion mechanism was removed; focused guard/held-out suite returned GREEN (25 passed). Complete xdist inventory then produced 14,019 passed/174 skipped plus one live Jira index-visibility regression (reopened dutiable-shaded-honeyeater) and the supported non-external inventory produced 14,019 passed/54 skipped plus one unrelated current-main RP-04 lazy-import/monkeypatch order failure now under a dedicated rebar-debug investigation. Patch-local lint, format, complexity, typecheck, diff check, and hooks pass. Amended local commit: 9cf89d7a9a. No Gerrit push until the unrelated current-main order failure is resolved and the supported full inventory is green.
